detail: Full summary: Same verb pair (override on A + commit_hashes on B) both CONFLICTED (V5 gitexp3, tiny record) and merged cleanly (judge nomerge-attr.sh, different key placement) — the deciding variable is line adjacency under sorted-key one-per-line serialization: a new key that sorts LAST rewrites the previous line's trailing comma. 'Disjoint keys merge cleanly' is therefore false as a rule; the docs now state the adjacency condition and keep AUTO-SAFE at add/add only.
